title: Range-Doppler map
line: 64 pulses resolve three targets in range and closing speed.
description: Range-Doppler map of an X-band pulse-Doppler radar: 64 pulses of a 10 us chirp, matched-filtered in range and transformed across pulses into closing speed. Two moving targets, one stationary target and ground clutter at zero speed.
thumbnailAlt: Range-Doppler map of three targets and ground clutter from an X-band radar, rendered by RunMat
